comparison.objective: Unload two books from a supporting hand, place them flat, and park that hand; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support transfer, object separation, and stable placement versus precision tool engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Both books must be preserved and placed flat, with no mandated sequence; candidate requires ordered unlock-adjust-cycle-relock operations and measured dynamic performance. Flatness and damage thresholds are unstated.
comparison.reason: Support unloading and placement are materially different from mechanical tuning.
